name: View of East India Company's Factory, Canton
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing made from a similar viewpoint to that of E.1775-1928, but showing junks and Tanka boats on the Pearl River, and the roof terrace recently built above the English 'factory'. The drawing is squared up in pencil for transfer to a watercolour or oil painting.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
